identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Simmitinib Versus Chemotherapy for Participants With Advanced Oesophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Simmitinib Versus Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy for Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Oesophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma : a Randomised, Open-label, Multicentre, Phase 3 Study

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Runshi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the overall survival of simmitinib versus investigator's choice of chemotherapy for Participants with advanced or metastatic oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma who have disease progression after first-line standard therapy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a randomised, open-label, multicentre, phase 3 study. Participants with advanced or metastatic oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma who have disease progression after first-line standard therapy will be randomly assigned to the experimental group or control group in a 1:1 ratio. The experimental group received treatment with Simmitinib, while the control group received investigator's choice of chemotherapy, include docetaxel or irinotecan.
